A gate serjeant stands watch over the restless crowd, casting cautious glances at the sturdy roster board nailed nearby. The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and smoke from nearby wagons, as refugees and travelers jostle to inch forward beneath the heavy crush held by vigilant guards. Amid them, threadbare watchers blend into the mix, their eyes darting more to the faces and packs than the gate itself. Near a rain-soaked barrel, a tavern runner hawks steaming bowls of hot stew, punctuating offers with murmured rumors for coin. Prominently posted on a weathered notice board are new taxes, strict curfew rules, and a stark warning about a missing patrol that has unsettled the district. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the caravan choke point here, amplifying the tension and pressing the crowd into uneasy stasis beneath a well-appointed townhouse that silently flies its noble colors in sharp contrast to the clamoring dirt below.

attempt_1.text: Cold rain spatters the soot-dark stone of Cinderwatch's eastern gate, where frayed banners flutter above the muddy approach. A gate serjeant stands watch over the restless crowd, casting cautious glances at the sturdy roster board nailed nearby. The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and smoke from nearby wagons, as refugees and travelers jostle to inch forward beneath the heavy crush held by vigilant guards. Amid them, threadbare watchers blend into the mix, their eyes darting more to the faces and packs than the gate itself. Near a rain-soaked barrel, a tavern runner hawks steaming bowls of hot stew, punctuating offers with murmured rumors for coin. Prominently posted on a weathered notice board are new taxes, strict curfew rules, and a stark warning about a missing patrol that has unsettled the district. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the caravan choke point here, amplifying the tension and pressing the crowd into uneasy stasis beneath a well-appointed townhouse that silently flies its noble colors in sharp contrast to the clamoring dirt below.
